+import os
+import time
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+ASSEMBLYAI_API_BASE = "https://api.assemblyai.com/v2"
+
+
+def _headers() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY is required")
+    return {"authorization": api_key, "content-type": "application/json"}
+
+
+def _get_transcript(transcript_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    response = requests.get(f"{ASSEMBLYAI_API_BASE}/transcript/{transcript_id}", headers=_headers(), timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def poll_transcription(transcript_id: str, interval_seconds: float = 3.0, timeout_seconds: float = 600.0) -> str:
+    start = time.time()
+    while True:
+        data = _get_transcript(transcript_id)
+        status = data.get("status")
+        if status == "completed":
+            return data.get("text", "")
+        if status == "error":
+            raise RuntimeError(data.get("error", "transcription failed"))
+        if time.time() - start > timeout_seconds:
+            raise TimeoutError("timed out waiting for transcription")
+        time.sleep(interval_seconds)
+

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: submit_transcription.py
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def submit_transcription(audio_path: str, model: str = "whisper-1") -> dict:
+    client = OpenAI()
+    with open(audio_path, "rb") as audio_file:
+        transcription = client.audio.transcriptions.create(model=model, file=audio_file)
+    result = transcription.model_dump() if hasattr(transcription, "model_dump") else transcription
+    return result
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Submit an audio file for batch transcription using OpenAI.")
+    parser.add_argument("audio_file", help="Path to the audio file to transcribe")
+    parser.add_argument("--model", default="whisper-1", help="OpenAI transcription model to use")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    if not os.path.isfile(args.audio_file):
+        print(f"File not found: {args.audio_file}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    try:
+        result = submit_transcription(args.audio_file, args.model)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(str(exc), file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
